plugins.name: 蓝调时刻
plugins.author: Manxia
plugins.description: 带一点雾蓝的清爽阅读室。浅色与深色模式都有配套表面色，跟随应用外观切换。

en.name: Blue Hour
en.description: A fresh blue reading room, with matching light and dark surfaces.

zh_TW.name: 藍調時刻
zh_TW.description: 帶一點霧藍的清爽閱讀室，淺色與深色模式都有配套表面色。

plugins.name: 本地收藏室
plugins.author: Manxia
plugins.description: 把书架、下载、足迹、插件和设置留在手边，适合主要阅读本地漫画的人。手动定制的导航优先于插件布局。

en.name: Local Library
en.description: Keep your library, downloads, history, plugins and settings close. Your manual navigation layout takes priority.

zh_TW.name: 本機收藏室
zh_TW.description: 把書架、下載、足跡、外掛和設定留在手邊；手動設定的導覽優先。

plugins.name: 日漫阅读习惯
plugins.author: Manxia
plugins.description: 横向分页、从右向左与宽屏双页。纸张翻页和暖色底更适合分镜漫画；逐本设置仍然优先。

en.name: Manga Reading
en.description: Right-to-left pages, wide-screen spreads, paper turns and a warm reading surface. Individual book settings take priority.

zh_TW.name: 日漫閱讀習慣
zh_TW.description: 向左翻頁、寬螢幕雙頁、紙張翻頁及暖色底，單本設定優先。

plugins.name: 暖纸书房
plugins.author: Manxia
plugins.description: 奶油纸色与茶棕点缀，适合喜欢纸质书氛围的阅读室。强调色可在插件设置中调整。

en.name: Warm Paper Room
en.description: Warm paper colors with restrained accents. Configure the accent in the plugin settings.

zh_TW.name: 暖紙書房
zh_TW.description: 溫暖紙色與克制點綴，可在外掛設定調整強調色。

plugins.name: 条漫长卷
plugins.author: Manxia
plugins.description: 连续纵向阅读、单页排列与深色背景，适合长条漫画。关闭此插件即可恢复原来的全局偏好。

en.name: Long Scroll
en.description: Vertical scrolling, left-to-right order and a dark surface for long comics. Disable the plugin to restore your base preferences.

zh_TW.name: 條漫長卷
zh_TW.description: 縱向捲動閱讀、向右順序與深色背景；停用後恢復原有基礎偏好。

plugins.name: 小夏 · 阅读伙伴
plugins.author: Manxia
plugins.description: 在书架、空状态和操作反馈中陪你阅读；支持静音、缩小或停用，阅读正文中自动隐藏。

en.name: Xiaxia · Reading Companion
en.description: Expressions for your shelf, empty states and action feedback. Adjustable, optional and hidden over comic pages.

zh_TW.name: 小夏 · 閱讀夥伴
zh_TW.description: 在書架、空狀態及操作回饋中陪你閱讀，可調整或停用，漫畫正文中自動隱藏。
